architecture.summary: Owner decision of 3 November 2026 (UTC): every verified account can create exactly one organization through hosted free access and choose its name; no account can create a second one. The WorkOS signup adapter no longer refuses an account with a membership record of any status in another organization (PR #320) or with a removed-member record (PR #322), and no longer gives an account with product access elsewhere only a Continue link. For an account without a saved organization at its personal external ID it now makes two reads (the current user and the external-ID lookup) and then creates the organization and grants the first Admin as before; the retained organization at the external ID stays the barrier and the only grant authority, so a second POST opens the same organization without a write. Public contracts change (contract, internalInterface): SignupState of the organizations-owned SignupActivation contract loses existing-account, SignupResult loses existing-account and existing-access (nothing produces them), and WorkOSSignupOptions loses the removedMembers option; the signup adapter keeps the OrganizationDirectory read only for Continue when the created organization needs support. The browser contract changes (contract): the existing-account page and its 403 answer go, the notice of a created organization says that each account can create one organization and offers Continue, step 1 and its account-exists message say that sign-in can create the organization, and the Switch Workspace page (GET /organizations) links Create an organization to the signup URL that app supplies. Composition (app) no longer gives the removed-member store to signup; member removal still writes the removed-member record as audit evidence and still answers unavailable without it, so the record, its table, the Pg read, and the migration are unchanged (no deployment or stored-data change). The registry removal view loses the edge of the signup read and the signup-refusal responsibility of the WorkOS adapter node (modelUpdated). No container, component, dependency edge, external integration, or trust boundary changes: the WorkOS calls of signup are a subset of the earlier ones. Team flag sensitiveBehavior: the admission rule of organization creation changes and the security file workos-signup.ts changes; every other guard stays: the origin check of each POST, the admission slots, the switch and the cap before any read, the email verification, the external-ID lookup before each create, recovery by external ID, and the Admin-only grant check. Legal bundle, env, and migrations unchanged.
